ON THE 19 th OF JUNE, 2023  CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 4489 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 FAROOQ @ SHAHRUKH S/O JAMAAT ALI, AGED ABOUT  35 YEARS, OCCUPATION: CULTIVATOR R/O VILLAGE  BHATPURA P.S. SIRALI DISTRICT HARDA (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI ISHTEYAQ HUSAIN-ADVOCATE)
 AND  1. STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH MAHILA  POLICE STATION HARDA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 2. VICTIM A  ..
 (BY SHRI NARENDRA CHOURASIYA-GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e court   following:

ORDER This first criminal appeal is filed by the appellant under Section 14-A(2) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.29/2021, dated 30.09.2021, registered at Police Station Harda (Mahila Police Station) Harda for commission of offence under Sections 376,
365, 452 of IPC and Section 3(1)(w)(i), 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

sentences.text: As prayed by learned counsel for the appellant, this first criminal appeal under Section 14-A(2) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act filed on behalf of appellant- Farooq @ Sharukh is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
